line_styles.P_AA(V): A|_V (x) A|_V component of P(eps,infty): wavy
line_styles.P_AA(W): A|_{W^perp} (x) A|_{W^perp} component of P(eps,infty): dashed
line_styles.P_lamlam: lambda (x) lambda component of P(eps,infty): straight
line_styles.P_cA*: c (x) A^*|_V component of P(eps,infty): dotted, arrow from c to A^*
line_styles.L_*: L_eps = (Q^GF (x) 1) K_eps edge pinned at t = eps (eps d/deps P(eps,infty) = -eps L_eps): grey band under the species style, label L_eps
line_styles.K_*: K_eps edge pinned at t = eps (Delta_eps = -partial_{K_eps}): grey band under the species style, arrow from field end to antifield end, label K_eps
line_styles.O: insertion of O = (iota_{w1}A, iota_{w2}A): double external line
line_styles.Delta: S^{(1)}(Delta) cochain (dilatation ghost): zigzag external line
line_styles.O_CT vertex: partial_delta I^CT[eps] vertex: FeynArts counterterm vertex (crossed circle)
line_styles.K-K0_*: special edge K_eps - K_0 of the QME defect (1/2)({I,I}_eps - {I,I}_0): grey band under the species style, arrow from field end to antifield end, label K_eps - K_0
line_styles.external antifield legs (round 2): A^*|_{W^perp}: dashed, lambda^*: straight, c^*: dotted; arrow towards the vertex (antifield end); external c and A^*|_V legs: dotted with arrow, as in round 1

diagrams.omega_note: 4 minus the external dimensions (c: 0, A|_V: 1): the (c, A|_V) part of the defect is a local polynomial of degree 3 in the external momentum
diagrams.defect_term: (1/2)({I,I}_eps - {I,I}_0): the special edge K_eps - K_0 (field end -> antifield end) joins two I vertices; every other edge is P(eps,infty)
diagrams.vanishing: zero: the one-loop part is a one-point function attached through a single edge; its value is a g-invariant element of g (tensor a Spin(4) x Spin(6)-invariant vector for A|_V), and g has no nonzero invariant elements

round2_symmetry_factor_crosscheck.method: independent Python enumeration of one-loop cycles with labelled external legs (build/crosscheck_r2.py) and per-graph |Aut| from the graph data (build/manifest_r2.py)

qme_defect_terms_without_special_edge.-Q I^CT[eps]: a single local vertex (no edge); its (c, A|_V) part comes from Q applied to the quadratic counterterms
qme_defect_terms_without_special_edge.-{I, I^CT[eps]}_eps: one I vertex joined by a K_eps edge to one I^CT[eps] vertex; at one loop the graph is a tree and has at least three external legs: no (c, A|_V) graph
qme_defect_terms_without_special_edge.hbar Delta_eps I: K_eps self-loop graphs: drawn (qdD_cAV_*), all one-particle reducible tadpoles, zero

round2_drawing_conventions.external_leg_labels: round-2 drawings (png/c3_*, q4_*, qd_*, qdD_*) and the composites of round-2 graphs and of route (ii) label every external field leg field(p_j), j = FeynArts leg number of the id (all momenta incoming); O and Delta carry no momentum label
round2_drawing_conventions.leg_order: the leg order of the id prefix; e.g. c,AV,AsV: leg 1 = c, leg 2 = A|_V, leg 3 = A^*|_V
round2_drawing_conventions.symmetry_factor: graph weight 1/s, s = |Aut| with external legs fixed; the K_eps - K_0 and K_eps edges count as species distinct from P(eps,infty)
round2_drawing_conventions.drawing_checks: every drawing is read back from its TeX and compared with the FeynArts record (vertex of every external leg, external line style and arrow, internal line style, grey band and arrow): build/texgraph.py; label overlaps and label-line clearance are checked with LaTeX-measured label boxes and repaired: build/labelfix.py
